text: Main apni Jhansi nahi doongi. (I shall not surrender my Jhansi.)
We fight for independence. If we are victorious, we will enjoy the fruits of victory; if defeated and killed on the field of battle, we shall surely earn eternal glory and salvation.
I conjure everyone in the name of God to join us in destroying the oppressors for our mutual welfare and the protection of our Matrubhoomi.
If defeated and killed on the field of battle, we shall surely earn eternal glory and salvation.
We women are not meant only to wear ornaments. It is our duty to protect our motherland with the sword.
It is evident to all men that these foreign forces are perverters of all men's freedom. We must rise.
A true ruler fights at the forefront. A ruler who hides behind walls does not deserve to rule.
Our right to rule our land is divine. No foreign entity has the authority to dictate our destiny.
To die for the nation is to live forever in the hearts of the people.
My late husband devoted his attention to the art of Peace, but necessity now demands we master the art of War.
